intro.text: NextCure is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Beltsville, Maryland. NextCure's retained clinical, regulatory, CMC, and finance personnel support the ongoing clinical development of LNCB74 under the Company's Transition and Continuation Agreement with LigaChem Biosciences, manage the transition of patients enrolled in the SIM0505 study, and conduct the Company's efforts to partner, license or otherwise monetize its legacy clinical and preclinical assets. NextCure has entered into a definitive merger agreement with Avere Therapeutics and, upon closing, the combined company is expected to operate as Avere Therapeutics and to be listed on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol “AVRX.”
